analysis: No verified fills yet — the strategy has proposed trades but none filled inside displayed depth and limits (see its intents), or its trigger conditions have not met on the captured universe.

evidence.claim: Rule is a documented convergence hypothesis; the independent test is the forward ledger itself (verified fills and official settlements only).

failure_mode: One 2% probability upset per trade destroys ~50 winners at this stake. Settlement rules disputes (can_close_early, rules_primary wording) are the tail risk; the ledger records rules_primary with every entry.
name: Expiry Convergence
rule: Inside 24 hours of expected_expiration_time (or close_time when no expected time is published), buy any side whose ask is between 0.90 and 0.99 on a universe market with volume >= 1,000, sizing 20% of cash, and hold to the official settlement.
why: In the final hours the remaining uncertainty is small and the 90-99c side is usually right; convergence trades pay 1-10c per contract with a high hit rate. Return-seeking: capital is kept working rather than parked.
